invariants.noLeasedWalletSelected: A wallet with an active operation lease is never receive-selectable, under any quarantine / retirement / recovery combination.
invariants.noLeasedWalletSilentlyReleased: A wallet with an active operation lease is never AVAILABLE (PINNED, or QUARANTINED when operator-quarantined); boot audit repairs AVAILABLE->PINNED only, never releases a lease and never clears quarantine.
